title: Microsoft’s global outage may be worse than Amazon's or CrowdStrike's, expert says
gist: A Microsoft 365 global outage beginning midday Thursday disrupted email, cloud and AI services for businesses, hospitals, banks, courts and governments; Microsoft blamed servers failing automated health checks, not hackers, and struggled for hours to mitigate. Former UK NCSC head Ciaran Martin suggested it may rank among the biggest outages ever, possibly worse than AWS or CrowdStrike.
